title: The Coffee Shop Debate
description: A scripted interaction about the philosophical implications of caffeine.

script.speaker: comedian
script.line: Is this coffee or battery acid? I think I just saw a ghost float out of the cup.

script.speaker: scientist
script.line: Technically, coffee is acidic, with a pH of around 5. It is unlikely to contain spectral entities.

script.speaker: philosopher
script.line: But what represents the battery? Is it the caffeine that powers our meaningless existence?

script.speaker: comedian
script.line: Wow. You really know how to kill a buzz. I just wanted a latte.
